name: infludubai
description: InfluDubai AI — creator marketplace for the UAE and MENA

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm --prefix backend ci --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend ci --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.migrate: npm --prefix backend exec -- prisma migrate deploy
